# Pance Design System: full reference

> Pance is an accessible React design system for social and data-heavy products: 71 components, 954 design tokens, WCAG 2.2 AA, light and dark mode. Packages: @pance/react and @pance/tokens, version 1.5.0, MIT.

This file is generated from the source (TypeScript props, token files and the decision register). Facts here match the published version above.

## Install and use

```bash
npm install @pance/react
```

Requires React 19. Without Tailwind: `import '@pance/react/styles.css'`. With Tailwind v4: `@import "@pance/react/tailwind.css";` in your stylesheet. Dark mode: set `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>`. More in https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/packages/react/README.md.

## Rules for using Pance

- Import components from `@pance/react`. Do not copy component source into a project.
- Colours and sizes come from tokens. Use the semantic utilities (`bg-primary-solid`, `text-ink-muted`, `border-line`) or the CSS variables (`--pance-*`). Never write a raw colour or a palette step in product code.
- Wrap every form control in `Field` so it has a visible label, hint and error association.
- Severity says what a thing means (`primary`, `success`, `danger`…); variant says how loud it is. Do not pick a severity for its colour.
- Status always carries an icon and a label, never colour alone. A chart series that means good or bad uses the status tokens; any other series uses the categorical palette, and a chart never mixes both.
- Scatter charts take at most two series. Beyond two, group the rest as "Other" or use facets.
- Built-in strings are props or `PanceProvider` labels. The library has no router or i18n dependency.
- Deprecated APIs stay for two minor releases and 90 days. Check the component page and the changelog before using something marked `@deprecated`.

## Components

71 components. Props are generated from the TypeScript source.

### Accordion

> Stacked sections that expand and collapse.

```tsx
import { Accordion } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/layout.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/layout.tsx) · Figma: `Accordion item` · Tokens: `accordion.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- FAQs and long settings where people read only some parts.

#### When not to use

- Content everyone must read.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `AccordionItem[]` | **required** |  |
| `allowMultiple` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | Heading level wrapping each trigger (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern). Match it to the page outline. |

#### Accessibility

- Triggers sit inside headings (`headingLevel`) with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; panels are labelled regions. Enter and Space toggle.

#### Related

[`Panel`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/panel.md) · [`Tabs`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tabs.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Accordion items={[{ id: 'a', title: 'How is usage billed?', content: 'Per million events.' }]} />
```

### Alert

> An inline message about the state of the page or a form, in context.

```tsx
import { Alert } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Alert` · Tokens: `alert.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Explain a problem, a warning or useful information next to the content it concerns.

#### When not to use

- Temporary confirmations: use `Toast`.
- Decisions that block the flow: use `ConfirmDialog`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `severity` | `Severity` | `'primary'` |  |
| `variant` | `SurfaceVariant` | `'soft'` |  |
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `onClose` | `(() => void)` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="alert"` for danger and warning, `role="status"` otherwise.
- Every severity has a default glyph, so meaning never depends on colour.
- The close button is named from the labels (`dismiss`).

#### Content

- Title says what happened; body says what to do next. Keep actions to one or two.

#### Related

[`Toast`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toast.md) · [`EmptyState`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/empty-state.md) · [`ConfirmDialog`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/confirm-dialog.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Alert severity="warning" title="Quota almost reached" actions={<Button size="sm">Upgrade</Button>}>
  You have used 92% of your events this month.
</Alert>
```

### Avatar

> A person or entity as an image or initials, with an optional presence status.

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/avatar.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/avatar.tsx) · Figma: `Avatar` · Tokens: `avatar.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Identify users in lists, comments and headers.

#### When not to use

- Decorative icons: use the icon itself.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | `string` |  |  |
| `name` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `size` | `number` | `36` |  |
| `ring` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `status` | `AvatarStatus` |  |  |
| `square` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `decorative` | `boolean` |  | Set when the name is already shown as text next to the avatar, so screen readers don't hear it twice. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` |  | Spoken status, e.g. a translated "Online". Defaults to the status key. |

#### Accessibility

- `name` is required: it is the accessible name and the source of the initials.
- Set `decorative` when the name is already visible next to it.
- If `src` fails to load, the initials show instead of a broken image.
- `status` is spoken through `statusLabel`; the dot is never the only cue.

#### Related

[`AvatarGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/avatar-group.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Avatar name="Camila Pérez" src="/camila.jpg" status="online" statusLabel="Online" />
```

### Badge

> A small label for status, category or a removable tag.

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/badge.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/badge.tsx) · Figma: `Badge` · Tokens: `badge.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Status of an item ("Active", "Failed").
- Tags and filters, with `onRemove`.

#### When not to use

- Counts on a bell or tab: use `CountBadge`.
- Anything clickable beyond removal; use a `Button` or `Link`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `severity` | `Severity` | `'secondary'` |  |
| `variant` | `SurfaceVariant` | `'soft'` |  |
| `dot` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `rounded` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `size` | `BadgeSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `onRemove` | `(() => void)` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

#### Accessibility

- Meaning is carried by the text, never by colour alone. Use `dot` or `Icon` to add a second cue.
- The remove button is named from the badge text ("Remove Beta"), shows the focus ring and has a 24 × 24 px target.

#### Content

- One or two words. Sentence case.

#### Related

[`CountBadge`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/count-badge.md) · [`TagInput`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tag-input.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Badge severity="success" dot>Active</Badge>
<Badge variant="outlined" onRemove={() => remove('beta')}>Beta</Badge>
```

### BarChart

> Compares values across categories, grouped or stacked.

```tsx
import { BarChart } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Chart / Bar` · Tokens: `chart.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Category comparisons and composition over categories (`mode="stacked"`).

#### When not to use

- Trends over many points: use `LineChart`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |  |
| `labels` | `string[]` | **required** |  |
| `series` | `Series[]` | **required** |  |
| `height` | `number` | `260` |  |
| `format` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |
| `mode` | `"grouped" \| "stacked"` | `'grouped'` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Every chart has a text alternative: arrow keys move between points and read out names and values, and "View as table" shows the same data.
- Series are never told apart by colour alone: markers, patterns and labels repeat the meaning.
- Colours follow dark mode through `color.dataviz.series.1…8`.

#### Related

#### Example

```tsx

```

- Long paths collapse into an expandable "…" button that is named.

### Button

> The primary way to trigger an action. Severity says what it means, variant says how loud it is.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/button.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/button.tsx) · Figma: `Button` (severity, variant, size, state) · Tokens: `button.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Submit a form, start a task, confirm or cancel a decision.
- One `filled` primary button per view for the main action; use `outlined` or `text` for secondary ones.
- Use `severity="danger"` for destructive actions, ideally behind a `ConfirmDialog`.

#### When not to use

- Navigating to another page: use `Link`, so the element is an anchor.
- Toggling a state: use `ToggleButton` or `Toggle`.
- Icon-only actions without a name: use `IconButton`, which requires a label.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `severity` | `Severity` | `'primary'` |  |
| `variant` | `ButtonVariant` | `'filled'` |  |
| `size` | `ButtonSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `TrailingIcon` | `Icon` |  | A second icon after the label, so one button can show both (for example Download with a chevron). Ignored when `iconPos` is `top` or `bottom`. |
| `iconPos` | `IconPos` | `'left'` |  |
| `rounded` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `raised` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `badge` | `string \| number` |  |  |
| `block` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |

Also accepts all native `<button>` attributes (`type`, `disabled`, `onClick`, `aria-*`).

#### Accessibility

- Renders a native `<button>`, so Enter and Space work and it sits in the Tab order.
- `loading` sets `aria-busy` and disables the button; keep the label so the action is still named.
- An icon-only `Button` (Icon, no children) needs `aria-label`; prefer `IconButton`.
- Focus shows the shared `pance-focus` ring on `:focus-visible`.
- Disabled buttons drop to 45% opacity; do not rely on that alone to explain why. Say it in a hint nearby.

#### Content

- Start with a verb and name the object: "Save changes", "Delete stream".
- Avoid "OK", "Yes" and "Submit" when a specific verb fits.

#### Related

[`IconButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/icon-button.md) · [`ButtonGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button-group.md) · [`SplitButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/split-button.md) · [`ToggleButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toggle-button.md) · [`Link`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/link.md) · [`ConfirmDialog`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/confirm-dialog.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Button Icon={IconCheck} onClick={save}>Save changes</Button>
<Button Icon={IconDownload} TrailingIcon={IconChevronDown}>Download</Button>
<Button severity="danger" variant="outlined" loading={deleting}>Delete stream</Button>
```

### ButtonGroup

> Joins related buttons into one control by collapsing inner borders and radii.

```tsx
import { ButtonGroup } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/button.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/button.tsx) · Figma: `Button group` · Tokens: `button.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Closely related actions or a small set of view options.

#### When not to use

- Choosing exactly one option: use `SegmentedControl`.
- Unrelated actions; keep normal spacing.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

#### Accessibility

- Each child keeps its own button semantics and Tab stop.
- Add `role="group"` and `aria-label` when the group needs a name.

#### Related

[`Button`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button.md) · [`SegmentedControl`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/segmented-control.md) · [`SplitButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/split-button.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<ButtonGroup>
  <Button variant="outlined">Day</Button>
  <Button variant="outlined">Week</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

### Calendar

> A month grid for picking one date.

```tsx
import { Calendar } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/date.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/date.tsx) · Figma: `Calendar` · Tokens: `calendar.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Inline date selection, or as the panel of `DatePicker`.

#### When not to use

- Birth dates far in the past: use separate fields.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string \| null` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `min` | `string` |  |  |
| `max` | `string` |  |  |
| `isDateDisabled` | `((date: string) => boolean)` |  |  |
| `defaultMonth` | `string` |  |  |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `bordered` | `boolean` |  | Draws the outer border, radius and surface. Off by default so the calendar can sit inside a popover or card. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Grid with one Tab stop: ←→ day, ↑↓ week, Home/End week start and end, Page Up/Down month (Shift: year), Enter or Space select.
- Dates are ISO strings (`"2026-10-15"`), never `Date` objects, so there are no time-zone surprises.

#### Content

- Month and weekday names come from `Intl` using `labels.locale`.

#### Related

[`DatePicker`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/date-picker.md) · [`RangeCalendar`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/range-calendar.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Calendar value={date} onChange={setDate} min="2026-01-01" />
```

### Checkbox

> Selects zero or more items, with an indeterminate state for partial groups.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/selection.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/selection.tsx) · Figma: `Checkbox` · Tokens: `checkbox.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Multiple choices, agreements, table row selection.

#### When not to use

- Immediate on/off settings: use `Toggle`.
- Exactly one choice: use `RadioGroup`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` | **required** |  |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: boolean) => void` | **required** |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no visible label (e.g. a table's row checkbox). |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `size` | `CheckboxSize` | `'md'` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Native checkbox semantics; `indeterminate` exposes `aria-checked="mixed"`.
- Space toggles; the label is clickable.
- `error` is shown with text in the `Field`, not only colour.

#### Related

[`CheckboxGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/checkbox-group.md) · [`Toggle`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toggle.md) · [`RadioGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/radio-group.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Checkbox checked={agree} onChange={setAgree} label="I accept the terms" />
```

### Combobox

> A text field with an autocomplete list of options.

```tsx
import { Combobox } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Combobox` · Tokens: `input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Long lists where typing is faster than scrolling, and values are known.

#### When not to use

- Short lists: use `Select` or `RadioGroup`.
- Free values mixed with suggestions: use `TagInput`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `{ value: string; label: string; meta?: string; }[]` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when not inside a Field. |

#### Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA combobox with list autocomplete: type to filter, ↑↓ move the active option, Enter selects, Escape closes.
- The result count and "no results" message are announced.

#### Related

[`Select`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/select.md) · [`TagInput`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tag-input.md) · [`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="City"><Combobox options={cities} value={city} onChange={setCity} /></Field>
```

### ConfirmDialog

> A modal for decisions that are hard to undo, with optional type-to-confirm.

```tsx
import { ConfirmDialog } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/dialogs.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/dialogs.tsx) · Figma: `Confirm dialog` · Tokens: `modal.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Deleting data, revoking access, anything irreversible.

#### When not to use

- Reversible actions: do them and offer Undo with a `Toast` action.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | **required** |  |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | **required** |  |
| `onConfirm` | `() => void` | **required** |  |
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `confirmLabel` | `string` | **required** | Text of the confirm button, as an action: "Delete stream". |
| `cancelLabel` | `string` |  | Defaults to the translated "Cancel". |
| `severity` | `Severity` | `'danger'` |  |
| `icon` | `Icon` | `IconTrash` |  |
| `requireText` | `string` |  | Phrase to type before the confirm button is enabled. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Built on `Modal`: focus trap, Escape, focus return. The confirm button stays disabled until `requireText` matches.

#### Content

- Name the action in `confirmLabel` ("Delete stream"); never "OK". Say what will be lost in `description`.

#### Related

[`Modal`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/modal.md) · [`Toast`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toast.md) · [`Alert`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/alert.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<ConfirmDialog open={open} onClose={close} onConfirm={remove} title="Delete stream?" description="Events will be lost." confirmLabel="Delete stream" requireText="checkout-events" />
```

### DataTable

> A sortable, searchable, selectable table with pagination and a mobile card view.

```tsx
import { DataTable } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/table.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/table.tsx) · Figma: `Data table`, `Data table row`, `Columns popover` · Tokens: `data-table.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Records people scan, compare, sort or act on.
- Expandable rows (`renderExpanded`), column visibility (`columnToggle`), loading and empty states.

#### When not to use

- Layout. Few simple rows: a plain list is lighter.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `Column<T>[]` | **required** |  |
| `rows` | `T[]` | **required** |  |
| `rowKey` | `(row: T) => string` | **required** |  |
| `rowLabel` | `(row: T) => string` | **required** | Name of a row for screen readers, e.g. "checkout-events". Used by the selection checkbox. |
| `caption` | `string` | **required** | Visible title; also the table's accessible name. |
| `sort` | `SortState` |  | Controlled sort. Omit to let the table sort by itself. |
| `onSortChange` | `((sort: SortState) => void)` |  |  |
| `selectable` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `selected` | `Set<string>` |  |  |
| `onSelectedChange` | `((selected: Set<string>) => void)` |  |  |
| `density` | `Density` | `'default'` |  |
| `pageSize` | `number` |  | Enables pagination. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `search` | `string` |  | Controlled search text; the table does not filter, you pass the filtered `rows`. |
| `onSearchChange` | `((value: string) => void)` |  |  |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Toolbar content shown when no rows are selected. |
| `rowActions` | `((row: T) => ReactNode)` |  | Per-row trailing cell, e.g. a DropdownMenu. |
| `empty` | `ReactNode` |  | Replaces the default "No results" state. |
| `renderExpanded` | `((row: T) => ReactNode)` |  | Adds an expand button to each row; its content renders in a full-width row below. |
| `columnToggle` | `boolean` |  | Adds a "Columns" menu to hide and show columns. The first column is the row header and always stays. |

#### Accessibility

- A real `<table>` with a caption, column headers, `aria-sort`, a row header column and named selection checkboxes.
- Expand buttons have `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` and are named by `rowLabel`.
- On small screens it becomes labelled cards with the same data and actions.
- It sorts and paginates the rows you pass; for server data control `sort` and pass the current page.

#### Related

[`Pagination`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/pagination.md) · [`EmptyState`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/empty-state.md) · [`Checkbox`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/checkbox.md) · [`Popover`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/popover.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<DataTable
  caption="Streams"
  rowLabel={(r) => r.name}
  rowKey={(r) => r.id}
  rows={rows}
  columns={[{ key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true }, { key: 'events', header: 'Events', align: 'end' }]}
  columnToggle
/>
```

### DatePicker

> A button that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date.

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/date.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/date.tsx) · Figma: `Date picker` · Tokens: `date-picker.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Date fields in forms.

#### When not to use

- Dates the person knows by heart: a typed field may be faster.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |
| `value` | `string \| null` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(value: string \| null) => void` | **required** |  |
| `min` | `string` |  |  |
| `max` | `string` |  |  |
| `isDateDisabled` | `((date: string) => boolean)` |  |  |
| `clearable` | `boolean` | `true` | Show a "Clear" action. |

#### Accessibility

- Use inside `Field`: label and value form the accessible name. Non-modal dialog; Escape closes and refocuses the trigger. The panel shifts or opens upwards to stay on screen.
- Dates are ISO strings (`"2026-10-15"`), never `Date` objects, so there are no time-zone surprises.

#### Related

[`Calendar`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/calendar.md) · [`DateRangePicker`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/date-range-picker.md) · [`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Start date"><DatePicker value={d} onChange={setD} clearable /></Field>
```

### DivergingBarChart

#### Accessibility

- Every chart has a text alternative: arrow keys move between points and read out names and values, and "View as table" shows the same data.

### DonutChart

> Shows parts of a whole.

```tsx
import { DonutChart } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Chart / Donut` · Tokens: `chart.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Up to about 5 slices that sum to a meaningful total.

#### When not to use

- Many categories or comparing similar sizes: use `RankedBarChart`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |  |

| `format` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |
| `size` | `number` | `180` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Every chart has a text alternative: arrow keys move between points and read out names and values, and "View as table" shows the same data.
- Series are never told apart by colour alone: markers, patterns and labels repeat the meaning.
- Colours follow dark mode through `color.dataviz.series.1…8`.
- Every slice carries a text label with its value.

#### Related

[`RankedBarChart`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/ranked-bar-chart.md)

#### Example

### DropdownMenu

> A menu of actions opened from a button.

```tsx
import { DropdownMenu } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/overlays.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/overlays.tsx) · Figma: `Menu`, `Menu item` · Tokens: `dropdown-menu.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Row actions, overflow menus, account menus.

#### When not to use

- Choosing a value: use `Select`.
- Navigation: use links.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |
| `items` | `DropdownItem[]` | **required** |  |
| `align` | `"start" \| "end"` | `'start'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the menu; defaults to the trigger's text. |

#### Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA menu button: Enter, Space or ↓ opens on the first item, ↑ on the last; arrows and Home/End move; Enter activates; Escape closes; Tab leaves.
- The menu stays on screen: it shifts sideways to fit the viewport or a clipping container, and opens upwards when there is no room below.

#### Content

- Items are verbs. Put destructive items last and mark them `danger`.

#### Related

[`SplitButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/split-button.md) · [`Popover`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/popover.md) · [`Select`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/select.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<DropdownMenu label="Row actions" trigger={<IconButton Icon={IconDots} label="More actions" />} items={[{ type: 'item', label: 'Rename' }, { type: 'item', label: 'Delete', danger: true }]} />
```

### EmptyState

> Explains why there is nothing to show and offers one next step.

```tsx
import { EmptyState } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Empty state` · Tokens: `empty-state.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Empty lists, zero search results, first-run screens.

#### When not to use

- Errors: use `Alert`.
- Loading: use `Skeleton`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `action` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` |  |
| `className` | `string` | `''` |  |

#### Accessibility

- The title is a real heading; set `headingLevel` to keep the document outline correct.
- Decorative icons are hidden from assistive tech.

#### Content

- Say what is missing and why, then give a single clear action.

[`Alert`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/alert.md) · [`DataTable`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/data-table.md) · [`Skeleton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/skeleton.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<EmptyState Icon={IconFolder} title="No streams yet" description="Create your first stream to start collecting events." action={<Button>Create stream</Button>} />
```

### Field

> Labels a control and connects its hint, error and character count to it for assistive technology.

```tsx
import { Field } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Field` · Tokens: `field.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Around every form control: Input, Textarea, Select, Combobox, DatePicker, TagInput and others.

#### When not to use

- Around a group of checkboxes or radios: they have their own `title` or `label`. Use `group` only when the field holds several buttons or chips.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `group` | `boolean` |  | Set when the field holds several controls (buttons, radios, chips). The label then names a role="group". |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `success` | `string` |  |  |
| `required` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `optional` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `charCount` | `number` |  |  |
| `maxChars` | `number` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

#### Accessibility

- Gives the control an `id` for the `<label>`, `aria-describedby` for hint, error and count, `aria-invalid` and `aria-required`.
- Errors replace the hint and are announced politely.
- Custom controls read the wiring with `useFieldControl()`.
- Mark optional fields with `optional`; mark required ones with `required` (adds text, not only an asterisk).

#### Content

- Labels are nouns: "Email address". Hints explain format or why you ask. Errors say what to do: "Enter a date after 1 Jan".

#### Related

[`Input`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/input.md) · [`Textarea`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/textarea.md) · [`Select`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/select.md) · [`DatePicker`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/date-picker.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Bio" hint="Up to 160 characters" maxChars={160} charCount={bio.length}>
  <Textarea value={bio} onChange={(e) => setBio(e.target.value)} />
</Field>
```

### FileDropzone

> A drag-and-drop area built on a native file input.

```tsx
import { FileDropzone } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `File dropzone` · Tokens: `file-dropzone.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Uploading one or several files with a clear accepted format.

#### When not to use

- Tiny uploads in dense forms where a plain file input is enough.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `accept` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `onFiles` | `((files: FileList) => void)` |  |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- It is a `<label>` around the native input: click, Enter and Space open the file picker, no drag required.
- Text such as "click to upload, or drag and drop" comes from `PanceProvider` labels.
- Report errors (type, size) in a `Field` error or `Alert`, not only visually.

#### Content

- State accepted types and limits in `hint`: "PNG or CSV, up to 10 MB".

#### Related

[`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md) · [`Alert`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/alert.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<FileDropzone accept=".csv" hint="CSV up to 10 MB" onFiles={(files) => upload(files)} />
```

### Heatmap

> A grid where cell intensity shows a value.

```tsx
import { Heatmap } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Chart / Heatmap` · Tokens: `chart.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Patterns across two categories, e.g. hour by weekday.

#### When not to use

- Exact comparison.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |  |
| `rows` | `string[]` | **required** |  |
| `cols` | `string[]` | **required** |  |
| `data` | `number[][]` | **required** |  |
| `format` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Every chart has a text alternative: arrow keys move between points and read out names and values, and "View as table" shows the same data.
- Series are never told apart by colour alone: markers, patterns and labels repeat the meaning.
- Colours follow dark mode through `color.dataviz.series.1…8`.
- Each cell has a text value in the table view.

#### Related

[`BarChart`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/bar-chart.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Heatmap title="Traffic by hour" rows={days} cols={hours} data={grid} />
```

### IconButton

> A square, bordered button that shows only an icon. The label is required and becomes its accessible name.

```tsx
import { IconButton } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/button.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/button.tsx) · Figma: `IconButton` · Tokens: `button.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Toolbar and table row actions where text would not fit.
- Close, copy, refresh and similar well-known glyphs.

#### When not to use

- Primary actions: a visible label is clearer, use `Button`.
- Glyphs people may not recognise without text.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Icon` | `Icon` | **required** |  |
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |

Also accepts native `<button>` attributes.

#### Accessibility

- `label` is required and is set as `aria-label`.
- Wrap in `Tooltip` when the glyph needs explaining; the tooltip also appears on keyboard focus.
- Hit area is 40×40.

#### Content

- Name the action, not the picture: "Copy link", not "Clipboard".

#### Related

[`Button`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button.md) · [`Tooltip`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tooltip.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<IconButton Icon={IconCopy} label="Copy link" onClick={copy} />
```

### InlineEdit

> Text that turns into an input on click and commits on Enter.

```tsx
import { InlineEdit } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Inline edit` · Tokens: `input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Renaming an item in place where a full form would be heavy.

#### When not to use

- Fields that need validation messages: use a `Field` and a form.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- The display state is a button that says what it edits; Enter commits and Escape cancels, returning focus to the button.

#### Related

[`Input`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/input.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<InlineEdit value={name} onChange={setName} placeholder="Untitled stream" />
```

### Input

> A single-line text field in three sizes, with optional leading and trailing icons and error or success states.

```tsx
import { Input } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Input` (size, state) · Tokens: `input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Short free text: names, emails, search, numbers.
- `type="password"` for secrets; it adds a show/hide toggle.

#### When not to use

- Long text: use `Textarea`.
- A choice from a fixed list: use `Select`, `Combobox` or `RadioGroup`.
- Unlabelled: always wrap in `Field` or provide `aria-label`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ref` | `Ref<HTMLInputElement>` |  |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `TrailingIcon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `success` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `inputSize` | `InputSize` | `'md'` |  |

Also accepts native `<input>` attributes (`type`, `value`, `onChange`, `placeholder`, `autoComplete`).

#### Accessibility

- Inside `Field` it is wired automatically: label via `id`, `aria-describedby` for hint, error and count, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required`.
- The password toggle is in the Tab order and uses `aria-pressed`.
- Placeholders are not labels; they disappear and have low contrast by design.
- Error and success are shown by border plus message text, not colour alone.

#### Content

- Placeholder shows an example, not an instruction: "name@company.com".

#### Related

[`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md) · [`InputGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/input-group.md) · [`Textarea`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/textarea.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Email" hint="We only use it for receipts" required>
  <Input type="email" placeholder="name@company.com" autoComplete="email" />
</Field>
```

### InputGroup

> An input with attached prefix, suffix, icons or a button that share one focus ring.

```tsx
import { InputGroup } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Input group` · Tokens: `input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Units ("kg"), protocols ("https://"), search with a submit button.

#### When not to use

- Plain inputs: use `Input`.
- Complex composites with several fields: lay out separate `Field`s.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | `string` |  |  |
| `suffix` | `string` |  |  |
| `prefixIcon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `suffixIcon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `suffixButton` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

Also accepts native `<input>` attributes.

#### Accessibility

- The add-ons are presentational text; make sure the label already states the unit.
- `suffixButton` is a real button and needs its own accessible name.

#### Related

[`Input`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/input.md) · [`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Website"><InputGroup prefix="https://" suffix=".com"><Input /></InputGroup></Field>
```

### LineChart

```tsx
import { LineChart } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Chart / Line` · Tokens: `chart.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

| `format` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Every chart has a text alternative: arrow keys move between points and read out names and values, and "View as table" shows the same data.
- Series are never told apart by colour alone: markers, patterns and labels repeat the meaning.
- Colours follow dark mode through `color.dataviz.series.1…8`.

#### Related

[`BarChart`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/bar-chart.md) · [`Sparkline`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/sparkline.md) · [`ScatterChart`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/scatter-chart.md)

### Link

> An inline navigation link that is always underlined, so it never depends on colour alone.

```tsx
import { Link } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/navigation.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/navigation.tsx) · Figma: `Link`

#### When to use

- Moving to another page or section, inside text or on its own.
- External destinations, with `external`.

#### When not to use

- Running an action in the page: use `Button`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"default" \| "subtle"` | `'default'` |  |
| `external` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `render` | `((props: { className: string; children: ReactNode; }) => ReactNode)` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

Also accepts native `<a>` attributes.

#### Accessibility

- Always underlined (WCAG 1.4.1).
- `external` adds `target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, an icon and spoken text "opens in a new tab".
- Use `render` to apply the styles to your router link while keeping an `<a>` in the DOM.

#### Content

- Link text should make sense out of context. Avoid "click here".

#### Related

[`Button`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button.md) · [`Breadcrumb`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/breadcrumb.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Link href="/docs">Read the docs</Link>
<Link href="https://example.com" external>Status page</Link>
```

### Meter

> One measurement against a known maximum, such as storage used.

```tsx
import { Meter } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Meter` · Tokens: `meter.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Quotas and capacity, with warning and danger thresholds.

#### When not to use

- Progress that only goes up: use `Progress`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `number` | **required** |  |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `unit` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `severity` | `MeterSeverity` | `'default'` |  |
| `format` | `((n: number) => string)` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="meter"` with `aria-valuetext`; warning and danger also print "Warning" or "Critical", so colour is never the only cue.

#### Related

[`Progress`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/progress.md) · [`MetricCard`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/metric-card.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Meter label="Storage" value={82} unit="%" severity="warning" />
```

### MetricCard

> A key figure with context: label, value, change, trend and state.

```tsx
import { MetricCard } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/data.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/data.tsx) · Figma: `Metric card` · Tokens: `metric-card.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Headline KPIs. Variants: default, compact, hero, goal, breakdown, comparison.

#### When not to use

- Detailed series: use a chart.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `string` | **required** | Pre-formatted value, e.g. "18,204". Formatting stays with you, so locale and units are yours. |
| `unit` | `string` |  |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` | `IconChart` |  |
| `delta` | `number` |  | Signed percentage change. |
| `upIsGood` | `boolean` | `true` |  |
| `trend` | `number[]` |  |  |
| `trendLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible description of the trend, e.g. "Streams per day, last 8 days". |
| `caption` | `string` |  |  |
| `variant` | `"default" \| "compact" \| "hero" \| "goal" \| "breakdown" \| "comparison"` | `'default'` |  |
| `state` | `"ready" \| "loading" \| "empty" \| "error"` | `'ready'` |  |
| `onRetry` | `(() => void)` |  |  |
| `accent` | `Severity` | `'primary'` | Colour of the hero card. |
| `goal` | `{ current: number; target: number; format?: (n: number) => string; }` |  | variant="goal" |
| `breakdown` | `{ label: string; value: string; share: number; }[]` |  | variant="breakdown": `share` is a percentage of the largest part. |
| `comparison` | `{ previous: string; currentLabel: string; previousLabel: string; }` |  | variant="comparison" |

#### Accessibility

- Value, change and trend are text. `Delta` says "increase" or "decrease" and whether it is good. Loading, empty and error states are announced.

#### Content

- Format the value yourself (`"12.4k"`). Set `upIsGood={false}` for error rate, churn, latency and cost.

#### Related

[`Delta`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/delta.md) · [`Sparkline`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/sparkline.md) · [`Meter`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/meter.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<MetricCard label="Events" value="12.4k" delta={8.2} trend={[3, 5, 4, 8, 9]} trendLabel="Last 5 days" />
```

### Modal

> A dialog that blocks the page until the person responds.

```tsx
import { Modal } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/overlays.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/overlays.tsx) · Figma: `Modal` · Tokens: `modal.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Short, focused tasks and decisions that need full attention.

#### When not to use

- Information that can sit in the page: use `Alert`.
- Long forms: use a page or `Drawer`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | **required** |  |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | **required** |  |
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `size` | `ModalSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `iconSeverity` | `Severity` | `'danger'` |  |
| `footer` | `ReactNode` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="dialog"` with `aria-modal`, named by the title and described by `description`.
- Focus moves in, is trapped, Escape closes, and focus returns to the opener.
- Background scroll is locked.

#### Content

- Title states the task. Primary button repeats the verb.

#### Related

[`ConfirmDialog`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/confirm-dialog.md) · [`Drawer`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/drawer.md) · [`Popover`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/popover.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="Rename stream" footer={<Button onClick={save}>Save</Button>}>…</Modal>
```

### NavMenu

> A vertical app navigation with groups, badges and a collapsed icon-only mode.

```tsx
import { NavMenu } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/navigation.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/navigation.tsx) · Figma: `Nav menu item` · Tokens: `nav-menu.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Primary navigation in dashboards and consoles.

#### When not to use

- Switching content on one page: use `Tabs`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | `NavMenuItem[]` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(key: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Name of the navigation landmark, e.g. "Main". Needed when a page has more than one <nav>. |

#### Accessibility

- A named `<nav>`; the active item has `aria-current="page"`; groups expose `aria-expanded`.
- In collapsed mode, items keep their names for screen readers (and should have tooltips).

#### Related

[`Tabs`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tabs.md) · [`Breadcrumb`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/breadcrumb.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<NavMenu label="Main" value={route} onChange={go} items={[{ key: 'home', label: 'Home', Icon: IconHome }]} />
```

### NotificationCenter

```tsx
import { NotificationCenter } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/notifications.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/notifications.tsx) · Figma: `Notification bell`, `Notification panel`

#### When to use

#### When not to use

| `align` | `"start" \| "end"` | `'end'` |  |

#### Accessibility

- The bell's name includes the count ("Notifications, 3 unread"); unread items say so in text.

### Popover

> A small non-modal panel anchored to a trigger.

```tsx
import { Popover } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/overlays.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/overlays.tsx) · Figma: `Popover` · Tokens: `popover.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Extra controls or information that do not need the whole page.

#### When not to use

- Actions in a list: use `DropdownMenu`.
- Tasks that need full attention: use `Modal`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `trigger` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |
| `title` | `string` |  |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |
| `align` | `"start" \| "end" \| "center"` | `'start'` |  |

#### Accessibility

- The trigger gets `aria-expanded`; focus moves in on open; Escape or an outside click closes and refocuses the trigger.
- The panel stays on screen: it shifts sideways to fit the viewport or a clipping container, and opens upwards when there is no room below.

#### Related

[`DropdownMenu`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md) · [`Tooltip`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tooltip.md) · [`Modal`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/modal.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Popover trigger={<Button variant="outlined">Columns</Button>} title="Columns">…</Popover>
```

### Progress

> A bar showing how far a task has got.

```tsx
import { Progress } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Progress` · Tokens: `progress.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Uploads, imports and multi-step jobs where you know the percentage.

#### When not to use

- Unknown duration: use `Spinner`.
- A measurement against a limit: use `Meter`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | **required** |  |
| `severity` | `Severity` | `'primary'` |  |
| `showValue` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name, e.g. "Upload progress". Required by WCAG 4.1.2 when there is no visible label. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | Human-readable value for screen readers, e.g. "3 of 8 files". |

#### Accessibility

- `role="progressbar"` with `aria-valuenow`. Pass `label` to name it; `valueText` for a readable value such as "Step 2 of 5".

#### Related

[`Spinner`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/spinner.md) · [`Meter`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/meter.md) · [`Steps`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/steps.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Progress label="Uploading report.csv" value={64} showValue />
```

### Radio

> A single option in a set where exactly one can be chosen.

```tsx
import { Radio } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/selection.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/selection.tsx) · Figma: `Radio` · Tokens: `radio.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

#### When not to use

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |

| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |

| `onKeyDown` | `((e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void)` |  |  |
| `buttonRef` | `Ref<HTMLButtonElement>` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Use `RadioGroup` to get one Tab stop and arrow-key movement.

#### Related

[`RadioGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/radio-group.md) · [`RadioCard`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/radio-card.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Radio checked={v === 'a'} onChange={() => setV('a')} label="Option A" />
```

### RadioCard

> A selectable card for choices that need more room than a radio row.

```tsx
import { RadioCard } from '@pance/react'
```

#### When to use

#### When not to use

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |

| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Behaves as a radio; place cards inside a group labelled for assistive tech.

### RadioGroup

> A labelled set of options where exactly one is selected.

```tsx
import { RadioGroup } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/selection.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/selection.tsx) · Figma: `Radio group` · Tokens: `radio.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- 2 to 5 mutually exclusive options that should all be visible.

#### When not to use

- More than about 5 options: use `Select`.
- Compact toolbars: use `SegmentedControl`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `options` | `{ value: T; label: string; description?: string; disabled?: boolean; }[]` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `T \| null` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: T) => void` | **required** |  |
| `size` | `RadioSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `'vertical'` |  |
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="radiogroup"`, one Tab stop; arrows move and select; Home and End jump.
- The `label` names the group; `error` should come with a message.

#### Related

[`SegmentedControl`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/segmented-control.md) · [`Select`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/select.md) · [`RadioCard`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/radio-card.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<RadioGroup label="Plan" value={plan} onChange={setPlan} options={[{ value: 'free', label: 'Free' }, { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'Billed monthly' }]} />
```

### RangeCalendar

> A calendar for picking a start and end date, with one or two months.

```tsx
import { RangeCalendar } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/date.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/date.tsx) · Figma: `Calendar / Range` · Tokens: `calendar.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Report ranges, bookings.

#### When not to use

- A single date: use `Calendar`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `DateRange` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(value: DateRange) => void` | **required** |  |
| `min` | `string` |  |  |
| `max` | `string` |  |  |
| `isDateDisabled` | `((date: string) => boolean)` |  |  |
| `months` | `2 \| 1` |  |  |
| `defaultMonth` | `string` |  |  |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `bordered` | `boolean` |  | Draws the outer border, radius and surface. Off by default so the calendar can sit inside a popover or card. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Same keys as `Calendar`. Pick the first day then the last; a third click starts a new range. The preview follows pointer and focus.
- Dates are ISO strings (`"2026-10-15"`), never `Date` objects, so there are no time-zone surprises.

#### Related

[`DateRangePicker`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/date-range-picker.md) · [`Calendar`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/calendar.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<RangeCalendar value={range} onChange={setRange} months={2} />
```

### RangeSlider

> A native range input for picking a number in an interval.

```tsx
import { RangeSlider } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Range slider` · Tokens: `range-slider.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Approximate values where precision is not critical: volume, thresholds.

#### When not to use

- Exact values: add an `Input` or use steps. Do not use for two-handle ranges (not supported).

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: number) => void` | **required** |  |
| `min` | `number` | `0` |  |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `severity` | `"primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "danger"` | `'primary'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when the slider is not inside a Field. |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | Human-readable value, e.g. "40 %" or "3 replicas" (aria-valuetext). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Native `<input type="range">`: arrows, Home, End and Page keys work.
- `label` is required outside a `Field`; `valueText` gives a readable value such as "40 percent".

#### Related

[`Input`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/input.md) · [`Meter`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/meter.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<RangeSlider label="Alert threshold" value={t} onChange={setT} min={0} max={100} valueText={`${t} percent`} />
```

### RankedBarChart

> Horizontal bars sorted by value, for rankings.

```tsx
import { RankedBarChart } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Chart / Ranked` · Tokens: `chart.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Top-N lists with long labels.

#### When not to use

- Time series.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |  |
| `data` | `{ label: string; value: number; }[]` | **required** |  |
| `format` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |
| `unit` | `string` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Every chart has a text alternative: arrow keys move between points and read out names and values, and "View as table" shows the same data.
- Series are never told apart by colour alone: markers, patterns and labels repeat the meaning.
- Colours follow dark mode through `color.dataviz.series.1…8`.

#### Related

[`BarChart`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/bar-chart.md)

### ScatterChart

> Two numeric measures per point, to show correlation or outliers.

```tsx
import { ScatterChart } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/charts.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/charts.tsx) · Figma: `Chart / Scatter` · Tokens: `chart.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Relationship between two variables for a handful to a few dozen points.

#### When not to use

- Thousands of points.
- More than two series. In forms where any two marks can touch (scatter, bubble, maps, small multiples) the limit is two: fold the rest into "Other" or split into small multiples (DDR-DS-027).

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  |  |
| `points` | `ScatterPoint[]` | **required** |  |
| `xLabel` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `yLabel` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `formatX` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |
| `formatY` | `ChartFormat` | `compact` |  |
| `height` | `number` | `280` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Arrow keys move between points and read the name with both values; hover targets are 24px; "View as table" lists all points.

#### Related

[`LineChart`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/line-chart.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<ScatterChart title="Latency vs load" xLabel="Requests/s" yLabel="p95 ms" points={[{ label: 'api-1', x: 120, y: 80 }]} />
```

### SegmentedControl

> A compact single-choice control for switching a view or a mode.

```tsx
import { SegmentedControl } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/selection.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/selection.tsx) · Figma: `Segmented control` · Tokens: `segmented-control.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- 2 to 4 short options that change how content is shown: Day / Week / Month.

#### When not to use

- Navigating between sections: use `Tabs`.
- Many options: use `Select`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `{ value: T; label: string; Icon?: IconType; }[]` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `T` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: T) => void` | **required** |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | `'md'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the group, e.g. "View". |

#### Accessibility

- `role="radiogroup"`, one Tab stop, arrows select. Give it a `label`.

#### Related

[`Tabs`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tabs.md) · [`RadioGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/radio-group.md) · [`ButtonGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button-group.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<SegmentedControl label="Range" value={r} onChange={setR} options={[{ value: 'd', label: 'Day' }, { value: 'w', label: 'Week' }]} />
```

### Select

> A select-only dropdown built as a button plus listbox, with typeahead.

```tsx
import { Select } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Select` · Tokens: `input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Choosing one value from a list of about 4 to 15 items.

#### When not to use

- Fewer than 4 options: use `RadioGroup`.
- Long lists that need filtering: use `Combobox`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | `string[]` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when not inside a Field. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- Select-only combobox pattern: Enter, Space or ↑↓ open, arrows/Home/End move, typing jumps to a match, Enter or Space chooses, Escape closes.
- Always give it a name through `Field` or `label`.

#### Related

[`Combobox`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/combobox.md) · [`RadioGroup`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/radio-group.md) · [`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Region"><Select options={['Andina', 'Caribe', 'Pacífica']} value={r} onChange={setR} /></Field>
```

### Skeleton

> A pulsing placeholder that holds the shape of content while it loads.

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Skeleton` · Tokens: `skeleton.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Loading states where the layout is known.

#### When not to use

- Waits under about 300 ms.
- Unknown layout: use `Spinner`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` | `''` |  |

#### Accessibility

- `aria-hidden`; set `aria-busy="true"` on the loading container. The pulse stops with `prefers-reduced-motion`.

#### Related

[`Spinner`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/spinner.md) · [`EmptyState`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/empty-state.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<div aria-busy="true"><Skeleton className="h-4 w-40" /></div>
```

### Spinner

> An indeterminate loading indicator with a text name.

```tsx
import { Spinner } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Spinner` · Tokens: `spinner.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Short waits of unknown length, inside buttons or small areas.

#### When not to use

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |

#### Accessibility

- `role="status"` named by `label` (default "Loading"). The arc stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

#### Related

[`Progress`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/progress.md) · [`Skeleton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/skeleton.md)

### SplitButton

> A primary action with a menu of alternatives attached.

```tsx
import { SplitButton } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/button.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/button.tsx) · Figma: `Split button` · Tokens: `button.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- One default action plus a few variants, such as "Save" with "Save as draft".

#### When not to use

- More than about six alternatives: use a `DropdownMenu`.
- Unrelated actions.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `Icon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `severity` | `Severity` | `'primary'` |  |
| `size` | `ButtonSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `items` | `{ label: string; Icon?: IconType; onSelect?: () => void; danger?: boolean; disabled?: boolean; }[]` | **required** |  |
| `onClick` | `(() => void)` |  | Primary action. |
| `menuLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the arrow button. Defaults to the translated "More actions". |

#### Accessibility

- The arrow is a separate menu button with `aria-haspopup="menu"` and `aria-expanded`, named by `menuLabel`.
- Same keyboard model as `DropdownMenu`: Enter, Space or ↓ opens, arrows move, Escape closes and refocuses.

#### Content

- The main label is the default action. Menu items are alternatives to it, not a repeat.

#### Related

[`DropdownMenu`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/dropdown-menu.md) · [`Button`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<SplitButton
  label="Publish"
  onClick={publish}
  items={[{ label: 'Save as draft', onSelect: saveDraft }, { label: 'Schedule…', onSelect: schedule }]}
/>
```

### Steps

> Shows progress through an ordered process.

```tsx
import { Steps } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/navigation.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/navigation.tsx) · Figma: `Steps` · Tokens: `steps.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Checkout, onboarding and other flows with a known number of steps.

#### When not to use

- Switching views: use `Tabs`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `steps` | `StepItem[]` | **required** |  |
| `current` | `number` | **required** |  |
| `orientation` | `"horizontal" \| "vertical"` | `'horizontal'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the list, e.g. "Onboarding progress". |
| `statusText` | `{ complete: string; error: string; }` | `{ complete: 'completed', error: 'has an error' }` | Screen-reader suffix for complete and error steps (translate it). |

#### Accessibility

- The current step has `aria-current="step"` and each status is spoken ("completed", "error"), so it never relies on colour.

#### Related

[`Progress`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/progress.md) · [`Tabs`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tabs.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Steps current={1} steps={[{ label: 'Account' }, { label: 'Billing' }, { label: 'Confirm' }]} />
```

### SwitchRow

> A full-width row with a title, description and a switch.

```tsx
import { SwitchRow } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/selection.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/selection.tsx) · Figma: `SwitchRow` · Tokens: `toggle.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Settings lists where each option needs an explanation.

#### When not to use

- Single inline switches: use `Toggle`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `on` | `boolean` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: boolean) => void` | **required** |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `size` | `ToggleSize` | `'md'` |  |

#### Accessibility

- The label and description name and describe the switch, and clicking the row toggles it.

#### Related

[`Toggle`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toggle.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<SwitchRow label="Weekly digest" description="A summary every Monday" on={on} onChange={setOn} />
```

### TabPanel

> The content region linked to a tab.

```tsx
import { TabPanel } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/navigation.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/navigation.tsx) · Tokens: `tabs.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Wrap each tab's content so it is labelled by its tab.

#### When not to use

- Using it without `Tabs`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabsId` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `tabKey` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `className` | `string` | `''` |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="tabpanel"` labelled by the tab; hidden when inactive.

#### Related

[`Tabs`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tabs.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<TabPanel tabsId="stream" tabKey="Activity">…</TabPanel>
```

### Tabs

> Switches between related views of the same content without leaving the page.

```tsx
import { Tabs } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/navigation.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/navigation.tsx) · Figma: `Tabs`, `Tab` · Tokens: `tabs.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Peer sections of one object: Overview, Activity, Settings.

#### When not to use

- Steps in order: use `Steps`.
- Changing how the same data is displayed: use `SegmentedControl`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tabs` | `(string \| TabItem)[]` | **required** |  |
| `value` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `variant` | `TabVariant` | `'underline'` |  |
| `size` | `TabSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tab list, e.g. "Report sections". |
| `id` | `string` |  | Set it to link tabs to <TabPanel>s with aria-controls. |

#### Accessibility

- WAI-ARIA tabs with automatic activation: one Tab stop, ←→ move and select, Home and End.
- Give `label` to name the tab list; pass `id` and wrap content in `TabPanel` to link panels with `aria-controls`.

#### Content

- One or two words each. Do not wrap onto two lines.

#### Related

[`TabPanel`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/tab-panel.md) · [`SegmentedControl`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/segmented-control.md) · [`NavMenu`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/nav-menu.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Tabs id="stream" label="Stream sections" tabs={['Overview', 'Activity']} value={tab} onChange={setTab} />
<TabPanel tabsId="stream" tabKey="Overview">…</TabPanel>
```

### TagInput

> Collects a list of short values as removable chips, with optional suggestions.

```tsx
import { TagInput } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Tag input` · Tokens: `tag-input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Tags, keywords, email recipients.

#### When not to use

- Choosing from a fixed set only: use `Combobox` or checkboxes.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tags` | `string[]` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(tags: string[]) => void` | **required** |  |
| `placeholder` | `string` |  |  |
| `suggestions` | `string[]` | `[]` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when the input isn't inside a <Field>. |

#### Accessibility

- Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes the last tag; each chip has a named remove button.
- Suggestions are a listbox reachable with arrow keys.

#### Related

[`Badge`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/badge.md) · [`Combobox`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/combobox.md) · [`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Tags"><TagInput tags={tags} onChange={setTags} suggestions={['api', 'billing']} /></Field>
```

### Textarea

> A multi-line text field with a fixed 80px minimum height.

```tsx
import { Textarea } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/forms.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/forms.tsx) · Figma: `Textarea` · Tokens: `input.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Comments, descriptions and other free text longer than a line.

#### When not to use

- Single-line values: use `Input`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `error` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `success` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` | `''` |  |

Also accepts native `<textarea>` attributes.

#### Accessibility

- Same wiring as `Input` through `Field`.
- Show a character limit with `Field` `maxChars` rather than blocking typing silently.

#### Related

[`Input`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/input.md) · [`Field`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/field.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Field label="Message"><Textarea rows={4} /></Field>
```

### ThemeProvider

> Chooses light, dark or system and sets `data-theme` on the document.

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/theme.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/theme.tsx)

#### When to use

- Once at the app root.

#### When not to use

- Nesting providers.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `defaultMode` | `ThemeMode` | `'system'` |  |
| `storageKey` | `string` | `DEFAULT_KEY` |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |

#### Accessibility

- The system choice follows `prefers-color-scheme`. The choice is stored in `localStorage` and the app still works if storage is blocked. Inline `themeInitScript()` in `<head>` to avoid a flash.

#### Related

[`ThemeToggle`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/theme-toggle.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<ThemeProvider defaultMode="system"><App /></ThemeProvider>
```

#### When to use

#### When not to use

- Outside a `ThemeProvider`.
