### Toast

> A short, temporary message about something that just happened, with an optional follow-up action such as Undo.

```tsx
import { Toast } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Toast`, `Toast / With action` · Tokens: `toast.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Confirm a completed action; offer a quick Undo with `action`.

#### When not to use

- Errors that need attention or a decision: use `Alert` or a dialog.
- Anything the person must not miss: toasts disappear.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `item` | `ToastItem` | **required** |  |
| `onDismiss` | `(id: string) => void` | **required** |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="status"` (`alert` for danger). The dismiss button is named; the action button runs and dismisses.
- Do not auto-dismiss messages that contain actions too quickly (WCAG 2.2.1).

#### Related

[`ToastStack`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toast-stack.md) · [`Alert`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/alert.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Toast item={{ id: '1', severity: 'success', title: 'Stream deleted', action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: restore } }} onDismiss={dismiss} />
```

### ToastStack

> The fixed bottom-right container that stacks toasts as a labelled landmark.

```tsx
import { ToastStack } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/feedback.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/feedback.tsx) · Figma: `Toast` · Tokens: `toast.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Render once near the app root and feed it your toast list.

#### When not to use

- Several stacks on one page.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toasts` | `ToastItem[]` | **required** |  |
| `onDismiss` | `(id: string) => void` | **required** |  |
| `label` | `string` | `'Notifications'` | Name of the notifications landmark. |

#### Accessibility

- A labelled region (`label`, default "Notifications") so screen reader users can find it.

#### Related

[`Toast`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toast.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<ToastStack toasts={toasts} onDismiss={(id) => setToasts((t) => t.filter((x) => x.id !== id))} />
```

### Toggle

> An on/off switch for a setting that applies immediately.

```tsx
import { Toggle } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/selection.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/selection.tsx) · Figma: `Toggle` · Tokens: `toggle.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Settings that take effect right away: notifications on, dark mode.

#### When not to use

- Choices that need a Save button: use `Checkbox`.
- Selecting several items: use `Checkbox`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `on` | `boolean` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: boolean) => void` | **required** |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `size` | `ToggleSize` | `'md'` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Accessible name. Required unless the switch sits inside a <label> or SwitchRow. |
| `labelledBy` | `string` |  |  |
| `describedBy` | `string` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="switch"` with `aria-checked`; Space toggles.
- Needs a name: pass `label`/`labelledBy`, or use `SwitchRow`.
- State is shown by position and track fill, not colour alone.

#### Related

[`SwitchRow`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/switch-row.md) · [`Checkbox`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/checkbox.md) · [`ToggleButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toggle-button.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Toggle on={on} onChange={setOn} label="Email alerts" />
```

### ToggleButton

> A button that stays pressed: filled when on, outlined when off.

```tsx
import { ToggleButton } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/button.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/button.tsx) · Figma: `Toggle button` · Tokens: `button.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Toolbar-style on/off options such as Bold or Follow.

#### When not to use

- Settings that apply immediately and need a visible switch: use `Toggle` or `SwitchRow`.
- Choosing one of several: use `SegmentedControl`.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `on` | `boolean` | **required** |  |
| `onChange` | `(v: boolean) => void` | **required** |  |
| `onLabel` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `offLabel` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `OnIcon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `OffIcon` | `Icon` |  |  |
| `size` | `ButtonSize` | `'md'` |  |

#### Accessibility

- Sets `aria-pressed`. Keep the label the same in both states, or change it with `onLabel`/`offLabel` and never both the label and the state at once in a confusing way.
- Enter and Space toggle.

#### Related

[`Toggle`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/toggle.md) · [`SwitchRow`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/switch-row.md) · [`Button`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/button.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<ToggleButton on={following} onChange={setFollowing} onLabel="Following" offLabel="Follow" />
```

### Tooltip

> A short label that appears on hover and keyboard focus.

```tsx
import { Tooltip } from '@pance/react'
```

Source: [`src/components/overlays.tsx`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/src/components/overlays.tsx) · Figma: `Tooltip` · Tokens: `tooltip.*` in [tokens.md](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md)

#### When to use

- Name icon-only buttons; add a short hint to a control.

#### When not to use

- Essential information or interactive content: use `Popover`.
- Touch-only contexts: tooltips need hover or focus.

#### Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | **required** |  |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | **required** |  |
| `placement` | `TooltipPlacement` | `'top'` |  |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |

#### Accessibility

- `role="tooltip"` and `aria-describedby` on the child. Appears on focus, stays while hovered, Escape dismisses (WCAG 1.4.13).

#### Related

[`Popover`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/popover.md) · [`IconButton`](https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/components/icon-button.md)

#### Example

```tsx
<Tooltip label="Copy link"><IconButton Icon={IconCopy} label="Copy link" /></Tooltip>
```

## Tokens

954 tokens in three tiers. CSS variable = `--pance-` + the token path in kebab-case (`color.intent.primary.solid` becomes `--pance-color-intent-primary-solid`). Product code reads semantic and component tokens; primitives are raw values. Every token with its value is in https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/tokens.md.

## Tokens: primitives

- `color.*` — 121 tokens
- `fontFamily.*` — 3 tokens
- `fontWeight.*` — 6 tokens
- `fontSize.*` — 15 tokens
- `lineHeight.*` — 5 tokens
- `letterSpacing.*` — 6 tokens
- `space.*` — 16 tokens
- `radius.*` — 6 tokens
- `size.*` — 20 tokens
- `duration.*` — 5 tokens
- `easing.*` — 3 tokens
- `opacity.*` — 3 tokens
- `blur.*` — 1 tokens
- `breakpoint.*` — 6 tokens
- `container.*` — 7 tokens
- `grid.*` — 6 tokens
- `zIndex.*` — 4 tokens

## Tokens: semantic

- `color.*` — 146 tokens
- `radius.*` — 6 tokens
- `shadow.*` — 10 tokens
- `focus.*` — 3 tokens
- `typography.*` — 14 tokens
- `motion.*` — 3 tokens
- `icon.*` — 7 tokens
- `gradient.*` — 4 tokens

## Tokens: components

- `button.*` — 146 tokens
- `badge.*` — 96 tokens
- `input.*` — 27 tokens
- `field.*` — 4 tokens
- `toggle.*` — 14 tokens
- `checkbox.*` — 17 tokens
- `radio.*` — 12 tokens
- `segmented-control.*` — 10 tokens
- `range-slider.*` — 8 tokens
- `avatar.*` — 13 tokens
- `tabs.*` — 18 tokens
- `steps.*` — 9 tokens
- `nav-menu.*` — 8 tokens
- `card.*` — 5 tokens
- `panel.*` — 4 tokens
- `accordion.*` — 3 tokens
- `alert.*` — 3 tokens
- `progress.*` — 3 tokens
- `skeleton.*` — 2 tokens
- `tooltip.*` — 8 tokens
- `popover.*` — 4 tokens
- `dropdown-menu.*` — 7 tokens
- `modal.*` — 11 tokens
- `drawer.*` — 4 tokens
- `toast.*` — 5 tokens
- `file-dropzone.*` — 7 tokens
- `tag-input.*` — 5 tokens
- `sparkline.*` — 7 tokens
- `metric-card.*` — 9 tokens
- `data-table.*` — 13 tokens
- `chart.*` — 6 tokens
- `calendar.*` — 16 tokens
- `date-picker.*` — 3 tokens
- `spinner.*` — 6 tokens
- `empty-state.*` — 9 tokens
- `meter.*` — 6 tokens

## Design decisions

Every decision is a DDR-DS record in https://github.com/lermajonathan/pance-ds/blob/main/docs/decisions/. Records are append-only.

- DDR-DS-001 (Accepted, 2026-10-14): Three-tier token architecture
- DDR-DS-002 (Accepted, 2026-10-14): The repo JSON is the source of truth
- DDR-DS-003 (Accepted, 2026-10-14): Brand colour is Aqua
- DDR-DS-004 (Accepted, 2026-10-14): Breakpoint `sm` stays at 640px
- DDR-DS-005 (Accepted, 2026-10-14): Heading 3 is 20px
- DDR-DS-006 (Accepted, 2026-10-14): Contrast fixes change four tokens and the warning button
- DDR-DS-007 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): Components read semantic and component tokens only
- DDR-DS-008 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): Dark mode is a semantic layer
- DDR-DS-009 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): Publish to npm with trusted publishing
- DDR-DS-010 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): Built-in strings are props, with no i18n or router dependency
- DDR-DS-011 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): One mature release instead of many small ones
- DDR-DS-012 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): One generated documentation page per component
- DDR-DS-013 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): Deprecation takes two minor releases and 90 days
- DDR-DS-014 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): Visual regression without committed screenshots
- DDR-DS-015 (Accepted, 2026-10-15): The Figma Code Connect map is kept by hand
- DDR-DS-016 (Accepted, 2026-10-16): One Figma page per component
- DDR-DS-017 (Accepted, 2026-10-16): Decisions are recorded as DDR-DS
- DDR-DS-018 (Accepted, 2026-10-16): Button can show a leading and a trailing icon
- DDR-DS-019 (Accepted, 2026-10-20): Four gradient tokens, decorative only
- DDR-DS-027 (Proposed, 2026-10-29): Data palettes: orange diverging pole and dark categorical steps
- DDR-DS-028 (Proposed, 2026-11-02): One status-colour system for charts and controls
- DDR-DS-029 (Proposed, 2026-11-02): Agent access through llms.txt, a read-only MCP server and a skill
